parsed.refutation_attempt: The code calls printf with a fixed format string: printf("Registro de compilación:\n%s\n", build_log); Since the format string is a string literal, any format specifiers present in build_log are treated as ordinary characters and are not interpreted by printf. There is no use of the build_log data in any command execution function (e.g., system, exec, spawn). Therefore the claim of OS Command Injection is unsupported. The only potentially unsafe operation is the allocation of build_log, but the size is obtained via clGetProgramBuildInfo, which returns the required buffer size. Hence no vulnerability exists.
